name: 145.3 — Installed: Update, Remove and Check for updates
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 145.3, in four runs: the hub-installed Installed row's Remove and no Update while the hub is at the record's version, the by-hand row with neither; 1.1.0 published and the manager reopened, `update 1.1.0` with Update watched in and the press watched to `staged 1.1.0`; after Reload UI, Remove pressed and `removed on Reload UI` read on both tabs; after Reload UI, no row on Installed and the Browse row empty with Install back.
